notes: Single-file HTML with Three.js (ES module via unpkg CDN). Procedural USP Match low-poly model: dark metal slide, bright silver barrel, polymer lower frame, match compensator, magazine. Fiber optic sights: front green, rear red. Flat shading, PS1 aesthetic, neutral gray background. 8-second loop animation: magazine slides up into grip → slide pulls back and resets on exposed barrel → explode view → reassemble. No external 3D assets, no TODOs.
